items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context. The interviewer mentions 'Hassan' and 'Max' (likely Max Roach) and a trio record, but the interviewee's response is about piano books and Billy Eckstine/Frank Sinatra, showing no personal connection to Hassan.

ctx.x: It was some piano books, stuff that wasn’t fixation in terms of the chordal picture, you weren’t locked into that. So I had to do it my way; like Billy Eckstine says, “My Way.” “My Way”, Frank did that, so I’m in with the guys (laughs).
We had a guy in Philly, when they talk about Cecil, Hassan.
Oh, Hassan, Max did a trio record with him.
